title: COUCH MODE WORKS INSIDE ITCH
why: coord-06 on 2026-10-21: inside itch frame the two windows could not link, because a BroadcastChannel is partitioned between the frame and the popup. When the game is embedded the pair now talks over window.opener, with the same words and the same pair code; the top level path is untouched.
now: On itch the player 2 window now links to player 1 through the page, and a player 2 window with no opener says so.

edits.anchor: if(typeof BroadcastChannel!=='function'||!netSupported()){ NET.err='This browser cannot link two windows of the game.'; netRefresh(); return 'unsupported'; }
